objects.name: Argonaut
objects.description: Rovan’s ONE Bastion-derived Argonaut, refitted with his newfound wealth. UNIQUE silhouette: elongated rigid bronze Zeppelin central hull, two shorter side gun hulls, wedge-shaped armoured ram prow and reinforced lower keel; crimson lacquer side armour between bronze ribs, low protected command citadel, TWO exposed green magnetic stabiliser rings near the stern, FOUR articulated bronze vectoring thruster pods with green Type B glow, rebuilt gun positions. Veymarch SILVER broken shield/eight-point star on crimson banners. Workshop-built industrial machinery, not ornate fantasy gold or a generic round-nosed Bastion. HEAVY CANNON UPGRADE: two prominent twin-barrel heavy gun turrets on the upper foredeck, four huge long bronze-and-black cannon barrels, much thicker and longer than standard Bastion deck guns, with reinforced recoil cradles and visible mechanical breeches. Keep the wedge prow and crimson plating. These are conventional heavy cannons, not new magical weapons.
constraints: Exactly one Argonaut. The three captured Bastions may appear alongside it only in explicitly post-surrender fleet scenes. No wooden hulls, sails or extra vessels.
Same ship after a refit, never an additional capital ship.
All hull armour is bronze Type A; machinery is green Type B. No silver Type C hull or invulnerability.
Canonical Argonaut refit design controls hull geometry; older generic Bastion art supplies ancestry only.
Keep the wedge prow, crimson side armour, paired green stern stabiliser rings and vectoring pods recognisable in every new exterior view.
The enlarged heavy cannons must be conspicuous in exterior views; do not shrink them to decorative small deck guns.
The refit takes a legendary FOURTEEN DAYS, using captured resources; it is the same existing ship.

world_constraints: One image per request; no multi-panel collage or embedded borders.
Compose for the fixed holder. Do not letterbox or paste the old wide image.
Preserve character faces, outfits, heraldry, weapons, metal colours and scene counts.
Keep essential faces, bodies and weapons inside the visible crop-safe area and outside lettering zones.
No unsupported new lore, extra Type C suits, extra capital ships or invented character names.

Floating-island backgrounds must have deliberately varied asymmetric silhouettes, geology, heights, scale and land use. Mix broad fractured mesas, thin tilted slabs, split rock spires and bare rubble, with open sky between them. Some fragments are uninhabited or vegetated; not every island carries an identical castle. Never tile, mirror or repeat the same inverted-cone island/city silhouette. Preserve a named location’s defining geography when changing camera angle.

Rovan owns FOUR capital ships: the original wedge-prowed Argonaut and THREE round-prowed prizes, Josephine, Serenity and Serendipity. Repairs and crimson repainting occur at New Frontier on page20 before the four sail for Oram. Do not show four copies of Argonaut or add a fifth ship. The three new prize captains are ordinary naval officers, not additional silver Type C knights.
Only FOUR owned capital ships exist in this fleet: Argonaut plus the three captured prizes. Respect the smaller count of ships requested for close-up shots.
The new prize captains are three ordinary naval officers, not additional silver knights. No Type C armour in these shots.
All raised house flags are Veymarch CRIMSON with SILVER shield/star. Fresh paint does not turn the standard prizes into Argonaut duplicates.
New Frontier is the conquered harbour. Oram is the next destination and is not yet reached or captured.

Background art direction: Behind the Argonaut put open blue sky and the cropped end of ONE broad stratified sandstone shelf, with low terraced warehouses rather than towers. One small distant needle of bare basalt is enough. Sparse horizon; absolutely NO rows of repeated islands, identical castles or waterfalls.

All airborne vessels are rigid mechanical bronze/metal Zeppelin-like ships. ANY wooden sailing boats or cloth sails seen in an old scene reference are obsolete errors: REPLACE them with small bronze Zeppelin commuter hulls, keeping background positions.
